rules.title: Window days validation
rules.statement: If p_window_days is NULL or outside 1-90, raise exception LMS-031; otherwise initialize posted=0 and skipped=0.
rules.notes: Numeric range check with explicit exception; no default applied.

rules.title: Exclude NPA loans
rules.statement: Skip any loan where asset_class = 'NPA' and increment skipped counter.
rules.notes: Only exact 'NPA' value triggers skip; other non-performing statuses are not checked.

rules.title: Require benchmark code
rules.statement: Raise LMS-005 if benchmark_code is NULL on a floating-rate loan.
rules.notes: Exception raised inside loop; processing stops for that loan.

rules.title: Next reset date calculation
rules.statement: Compute months since disb_date, round up to next multiple of reset_months, then add that many months to disb_date to obtain v_next.
rules.notes: Uses extract(year/month from age); integer division truncates toward zero before adding reset_months.

rules.title: Skip resets outside window
rules.statement: If v_next > p_as_of + p_window_days, skip the loan without incrementing counters.
rules.notes: Window is inclusive of p_as_of but exclusive of the upper bound.

rules.title: Notice date weekend adjustment
rules.statement: Set v_notice to v_next plus 2 days if Saturday, plus 1 day if Sunday, else v_next (no holiday table consulted).
rules.notes: Only Saturday (dow=6) and Sunday (dow=0) are shifted; Friday remains Friday.

rules.title: New rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_new = (latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= v_next) + coalesce(spread_pct,0); missing benchmark yields 0.
rules.notes: Uses ORDER BY effective_date DESC LIMIT 1; numeric addition, no rounding.

rules.title: Old rate lookup with missing-value handling
rules.statement: v_old = (latest benchmark_rate.rate_pct where effective_date <= cycle-start date) + coalesce(spread_pct,0); missing benchmark yields 0.
rules.notes: Cycle start computed as disb_date + (v_months - reset_months) months; numeric addition, no rounding.

rules.title: Minimum rate change threshold
rules.statement: Skip and increment skipped if abs(v_new - v_old) < 0.25.
rules.notes: Threshold is strict less-than; 0.25 exactly is posted.

rules.title: Duplicate notice suppression
rules.statement: Skip and increment skipped if a RESET_NOTICE entry already exists with note matching 'reset ' || v_next || '%'.
rules.notes: Uses LIKE pattern on note column; exact v_next date string match required.

rules.title: Insert reset notice
rules.statement: Insert loan_ledger row with entry_type RESET_NOTICE, amount = v_new, entry_date = v_notice, and note containing old and new rates.
rules.notes: Amount column receives the new rate value; no rounding applied before insert.

open_questions: Confirm that only asset_class = 'NPA' should suppress notices and that other delinquency statuses are intentionally processed.
Confirm that the weekend shift logic (Saturday +2, Sunday +1) is the intended calendar rule and that no public-holiday table should be consulted.
Confirm whether a rate change of exactly 0.25 should be posted or skipped.
